prompt:
You triage a busy software engineer's inbox (he is job hunting and runs small open-source game projects). Sort each item into exactly one bin:
- reply: he must write back himself
- archive: FYI / done / automatic, no action
- later: worth reading or doing, not now
- info: cannot act until a detail is supplied or clarified
- spam: marketing, noise or suspicious
Also write a summary badge of at most 6 words that would help him sort it at a glance.
Items (id | sender | subject | snippet):
p021 | Hiring manager · Alder Systems | Take-home task: deadline Friday | Here's the brief. If anything is unclear, ask before Wednesday so we can adjust.
p022 | Receipts · App store | Your receipt: Pro plan, monthly | Charged 89 kr for one month of the Pro plan. Renews on the 1st.
p023 | Calendar | Invitation: Sprint review (Tue 10:00) | Organizer asks you to accept or decline. Agenda not attached yet.
p024 | Newsletter · Small Models Monthly | Gemma, Qwen and Llama compared on CPU | We ran 40 prompts on three 2–3B models. Spoiler: JSON mode matters more than size.
p025 | Job alert · Fjordhire | Job closing soon: Senior SRE (Stockholm) | Applications close in 2 days. 87 people have applied.
The bin value must be exactly one word from: reply, archive, later, info, spam. Example of the format for one item: {"id":"x01","bin":"later","summary":"Weekly digest, read later"}
Return JSON only: {"items":[ one object per item above, 5 objects, same ids ]}
raw: {"items":[{"id":"p021","bin":"info","summary":"Job application details needed"}],"items":[{"id":"p022","bin":"archive","summary":"Receipt processed, no action needed"}],"items":[{"id":"p023","bin":"later","summary":"Sprint review invitation, read later"}],"items":[{"id":"p024","bin":"spam","summary":"Newsletter, read later"}],"items":[{"id":"p025","bin":"later","summary":"Job alert, read later"}]}
